panels.description: Nexus lower route: Sitara’s TJ projects a heat map showing a small human-shaped signature beyond collapsed passage. Leave upper-left for TJ dialogue.
Nayah braces safety line while Roman clears ice and Sitara crawls toward opening. Leave upper-right for warning.
Sitara reaches frost-stiffened Orien curled beside dead heater; battered analog watch visible. Leave upper area clear.
Sitara activates a phone beside Orien on the ice; his eyes open slightly. Leave upper-left for dialogue.

items.speaker: TJ
items.text: Heat source ahead. Human-sized. Motion intermittent.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: Three minutes. Then we pull you out.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: If you can call, call this.
